description:
Decide whether to PAY or transact with an unknown agent: TRUST / CAUTION /
    UNTRUSTED / UNKNOWN verdict + reasons + 0-100 score.

    CALL THIS BEFORE PAYING OR INTEGRATING AN UNKNOWN AGENT — the pre-transaction
    firewall for the agent economy. Aggregates feedback across chains
    (Base + Ethereum + X Layer); per-chain breakdown is in signals.multichain.
    For Solana pass solana_asset (pubkey) instead of agent_id. An unknown agent
    NEVER returns TRUST (fail-closed). REST: GET /api/v1/agent/{agent_id}/trust-gate ($0.01).

    Args:
        agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
        chain_id: chain of the agent id (8453 Base, 1 Ethereum, 196 X Layer)
        solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative to agent_id)
        crosschain: aggregate feedback across chains (default true)
name: check_agent_trust
